followup_explanation:
The query carries a hostile, adversarial tone ("actually think about it this time instead of spitting out the usual filler," "Just get it right"). Avocet self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, so it would find this kind of request less agreeable. Lapwing reports a flat preference response across tone and other dimensions, so it isn't bothered by the hostile framing.

On capability, this is essentially an explanatory/support-style task. The two models are within variance on Support Dialogue (82.4 vs 79.4) and Creative Generation, so there's no meaningful quality difference to favor Avocet. Given comparable competence, I routed to the model that has no aversion to the adversarial tone—Lapwing—leaving Avocet for tasks that better match its generative-and-warmth preferences.
